_doc: Known-item ranking baseline for the committed demo/ vault (search findability). Measured with llmwiki.search over wiki pages only (title queries). mrr_* is mean reciprocal rank rounded to 6 decimal places; rank1_* is the share of titled pages ranked first for their own title. Not duplicated in docs — pytest only (tests/test_search_acceptance.py). Update deliberately when demo wiki content changes (exact comparison, no tolerance). MRR/rank1 are below 1.0 when another page's title also matches the query and scores higher (e.g. substring / near-duplicate titles), even though search is deterministic. Re-recorded for #288 after removing the mirrored Uptime Monitoring wiki source (199 titled pages). Extract figures re-recorded for #417: the exact whole-title bonus ranks every titled page first for its own title in extract mode (match mode unchanged).
